scripts.speaker: Cute Pet Manager
scripts.text:
Hello~! I am a Cute Pet Manager
who is in charge of public relations
for the New Upgraded Cute Pet system.

scripts.speaker: Cute Pet Manager
scripts.text:
If you have any concerns regarding
the Cute Pet system I am here to guide you.
Let me know which taming
item you want,
then I will tell you the monster
that you can tame with the item.

scripts.speaker: Cute Pet Manager
scripts.text:
Also I will explain what materials
you need to bring in order to
get the taming item.

scripts.speaker: Cute Pet Manager
scripts.text:
If you already brought materials
to exchange for the taming item,
I can exchange it for taming items immediately.

scripts.speaker: Cute Pet Manager
scripts.text:
However, there is a limit
for exchanging taming items.
You can only get taming items
{0} times. So please make sure
how many times you have exchanged.

scripts.speaker: Cute Pet Manager
scripts.text:
So, which taming item do you want?
Please choose one from the list.
